# netbox_virtual_machine_type (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/virtualization/virtualmachinetype/):

> A virtual machine type defines default resources, such as the number of vCPUs and the memory, for virtual machines.

Requires NetBox v4.6.0 or newer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_virtual_machine_type" "example" {
  name = "example"
  default_vcpus = 2
  default_memory = 2048
}
```
